summary: Post-answer signup CTA at the highest-intent moment (non-blocking)
description: Depends on the public ask surface. After the guest answer finishes streaming AND entitlement is consumed, render a CTA BELOW the answer: 'You've used your free question — create a free account to keep exploring.' Do NOT overlay a modal before the user can read the answer. Wire buttons to Clerk sign-up/sign-in. Optional: gate a 2nd free question via pricing-config before the wall (start at 1).

resolution.note: GuestWall buttons route to /sign-up|/sign-in with redirect_url=/ask?continue=1 (Clerk honors redirect_url over fallback), hook-free so it renders without ClerkProvider. Copy matches spec; carry-over reassurance added. Return-trip import is child 45598ce4.
